verdict.rationale: Baseten has a dedicated Model APIs deprecation page. It tells users to migrate to a dedicated deployment with the deprecated model weights, so some deprecation guidance is documented first-party. But that page covers hosted model retirement, not API versioning, and nothing in the pack describes versioned API endpoints, deprecation timelines or notice periods. missing for 10: evidence of versioned API endpoints or version pinning, a documented deprecation timeline/notice policy for the API surface, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Migrate to a dedicated deployment with the deprecated model weights. Contact us for assistance.
